text:
rohan: Heads-up — seeing slow memory growth on long chat sessions. KV cache residency % declines over time but memory used keeps rising; evictions_count doesn't match expected churn.

ana: Can you paste a small timeline? Also which fleet/shard?

rohan: test convo on shard=us-west-2-a; snippets:
```
# sampling
kv_cache_mem_bytes{shard="us-west-2-a"}[1h]
kv_evictions_total{shard="us-west-2-a"}
kv_residency_percentile_bucket{quantile="0.99",shard="us-west-2-a"}
```
Observed mem +20% over 45m; evictions flat.

matt: Sounds like fragmentation/ghost pages. Two quick asks:
1) break down evictions by reason label (age, capacity, collision)
2) add residency histogram (0..1) and residency_percentile_{50,90,99}

keerthi: Agree. Also we should capture reuse-rate per fragment key and a frag_reuse_counter.
Prefer names: kv_evictions_total{reason=}, kv_fragment_reuse_total, kv_fragment_fragments_total, kv_residency_histogram

ana: Proposed dashboard panels:
- KV hit ratio (rolling 5m): `sum(kv_cache_hits_total)/sum(kv_cache_lookups_total)`
- Eviction rate by reason (stacked)
- Residency P50/P90/P99 over time
- Shard-level memory vs allocated_mem
- Fragmentation metric: `kv_fragment_bytes_total / kv_cache_mem_bytes`

ana: Quick PromQL examples:
```
# eviction rate per reason
sum by (reason, shard)(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]))
# residency p99
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(kv_residency_bucket[5m])) by (le, shard))
# frag ratio
(sum(kv_fragment_bytes_total) by (shard)) / (sum(kv_cache_mem_bytes) by (shard))
```

ying: Note: batching heuristics affect reuse — larger batches increase KV locality but also increase TTL of entries in-flight. When kernel selection switches to large-seq kernels we sometimes hold extra KV slices longer; add metric kv_inflight_fragments_count.

sam: I'll spin up a Grafana draft. I'll create panels + example dashboard JSON. Assigning to myself and @matt for review. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Incident reminder — evictions spike alert currently: `EvictionSpikeHigh` triggered 2w ago. Consider tuning alert to use rate > 100/min sustained 5m.

rohan: Thx. One more: sampling bias — we currently sample 1/100 sessions for residency; need to expose sample_rate gauge so dashboards can normalize. Add kv_residency_sample_rate.

matt: Good call. Also add labels: model, deployment, shard. Makes root-cause easier.

rohan: OK leaving backlog ticket. Thanks all. /cc @keerthi @ana
